title: Canadian electricity generation context
description: Annual Canadian electricity generation provides national grid context alongside the Ontario and U.S. data-centre scenarios.
plainLanguageSummary: This national generation series gives scale context; it is not a forecast of Canadian data-centre demand.
howToRead: Only complete calendar years are included. Compare it with the separate Ontario data-centre forecast by scale, not as an equivalent measure.

calculation.formula: Sum twelve monthly national electricity-generation observations and divide MWh by 1,000,000 to report TWh per year.
calculation.explanation: Generation is national supply context, not domestic electricity consumption or a data-centre load measure.
calculation.example: A value at date t uses only observations dated t or earlier unless the chart explicitly labels a visual shift.

patternsToWatch: The gap between national supply context and local grid constraints
limitations: Generation includes electricity that may be exported and does not equal domestic load.
National totals hide provincial and local transmission constraints.
No Canada-wide data-centre load forecast is included in this v1 source set.
sourceNotes: Statistics Canada monthly electricity generation by type, table 25-10-0015-01, vector 44174609

methodology.formula: Sum twelve monthly national electricity-generation observations and divide MWh by 1,000,000 to report TWh per year.
methodology.notes: Generation is national supply context, not domestic electricity consumption or a data-centre load measure.
